# Group the merged dataset by 'Country Group' and perform a linear regression analysis
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Separate the data by 'Country Group'
sub_saharan_africa = merged_df[merged_df['Country Group'] == 'Sub-Saharan Africa']
lower_middle_income = merged_df[merged_df['Country Group'] == 'Lower middle income']

# Perform linear regression for Sub-Saharan Africa
X_sub = sm.add_constant(sub_saharan_africa['Education Expenditure'])
y_sub = sub_saharan_africa['GDP']
model_sub = sm.OLS(y_sub, X_sub).fit()

# Perform linear regression for Lower Middle Income countries
X_lmc = sm.add_constant(lower_middle_income['Education Expenditure'])
y_lmc = lower_middle_income['GDP']
model_lmc = sm.OLS(y_lmc, X_lmc).fit()

# Display the regression results
model_sub.summary()
model_lmc.summary()

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Perform linear regression for Sub-Saharan Africa
X_sub = sub_saharan_africa[['Education Expenditure']]
y_sub = sub_saharan_africa['GDP']
model_sub = LinearRegression().fit(X_sub, y_sub)
coef_sub = model_sub.coef_[0]
